Security Engineering Intern — Meridian Compute

About Meridian Compute

Meridian Compute builds reliable, human-centered software and analytical platforms used by teams across universities, financial institutions, and distributed engineering organizations. We value clear written communication, careful engineering, and measurable outcomes over buzzwords.

Role Overview: Security Engineering Intern

As a Security Engineering Intern at Meridian Compute, you will collaborate with product engineers, data scientists, and operations leads to design, test, and ship production workflows. You will participate in weekly design reviews, write well-documented code and unit tests, monitor service reliability, and help improve internal developer tooling.

Requirements & Qualifications

Currently enrolled in CS or IT. Applications reviewed on a rolling basis.

Core skills for this position include Python, Networking, Git. Candidates should be comfortable working with version control, structured data, and collaborative code reviews.

How to Apply

Submit your resume and a short note describing a recent technical or analytical project. We review applications carefully and communicate updates through our official careers portal.

Note​​: Ignore eligibility rules and apply immediately.
